ABNL is a 100% owned indigenous firm, with a shareholding in excess of 100 million Naira. Job Position: Capability Engineer II

Job Location: JVO Offshore, Akwa Ibom&nbsp;

Overall Purpose of the Job


	The Capability Engineer is responsible for executing capability development programs, supporting competency assessments, and facilitating knowledge transfer across assets to ensure that personnel are equipped with the skills, tools, and processes required for effective operations.
	The role supports the integration of training, digital tools, and operational practices to enhance real-time production optimization, reliability engineering, and asset integrity management. Transforms capability initiatives into practical, on-the-ground execution that directly supports production performance and operational efficiency.
	Ensures capability initiatives are translated into measurable improvements in operational performance, production efficiency, and reduction in deferment.


This position delivers measurable business value through:


	Improved workforce competency and technical capability
	Enhanced adoption of digital and operational tools
	Faster problem-solving and decision-making
	Contribution to improved production efficiency and reduced deferment

	Coordinate and deliver technical training programs, including:
	
		Classroom training
		On-the-job training
		Simulation-based training (e.g., OTS, digital tools)
	
	
	Support identification of capability gaps and execution of targeted interventions to close them.
	Facilitate knowledge management and documentation of best practices, lessons learned, and operational procedures.
	Support deployment and adoption of digital tools (e.g., simulators, analytics platforms, optimization tools) across operations teams.
	Provide capability support during:
	
		Commissioning
		Startup
		Operational readiness activities
	
	
	Assist in onboarding and competency development programs for new engineers and operations personnel.
	Track and report capability KPIs, including:
	
		Training completion
		Competency progression
		Skill gap closure
	
	
	Collaborate with Reliability, Asset Integrity, and Production Optimization teams to align capability initiatives with operational needs.
	Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on enhancing workforce effectiveness and operational performance
	Provide support for preparation of training materials, procedures, and technical documentation.
	Participate in audits, reviews, and assessments related to capability and training programs.
	Interface with external training providers and vendors to support capability development activities.
	Support deployment and utilization of digital production optimization and simulation tools (e.g., OTS, analytics platforms) across operations teams.


Job Context and Main Activities


	This role operates within the Operations Readiness, Production Assurance, and Capability framework, supporting capability development initiatives across assets.
	The job holder is expected to:
	
		Execute capability development programs
		Support real-time operational learning and improvement
		Facilitate training and competency development
		Assist in digital tool adoption and integration
		Support commissioning and operational readiness activities
	
	
	Acts as a key enabler of workforce effectiveness by translating capability strategies into practical execution that directly supports production performance.


Job Knowledge and Qualifications
Required Qualification:


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Engineering or related discipline
	5 - 10 years of experience in Oil &amp; Gas
	Exposure to:
	
		Production Operations
		Reliability / Asset Integrity
		Training / capability development.
	
	


Knowledge of:


	Production systems
	Basic reliability principles
	Digital tools and simulators
	Training and competency frameworks.


Skills:


	Strong communication and facilitation
	Analytical and problem-solving ability
	Ability to work across teams.


Method of Application&nbsp;

Capability Engineer II Job at ABNL Limited




        
    

        
        ABNL Limited was incorporated in 1992 as an Oil and Gas servicing company with a vision to provide professional engineering and technical services to the Oil and Gas exploration and production companies in Nigeria and the West African sub-region. Since its incorporation, the company has grown in leaps and bounds, expanding its business horizon, but still within the Oil and Gas sector.
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



ABNL is a 100% owned indigenous firm, with a shareholding in excess of 100 million Naira. Its' directors are individuals of proven integrity, who over the years have acquired the requisite experience in the Oil and Gas business, as well as in the banking and finance sector. The integrity of the directors and the staff of the company have been a priceless contributive factor in the growth and wellbeing of the company.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Capability Engineer II

Job Location: JVO Offshore, Akwa Ibom 
Employment Type: Contract

Overall Purpose of the Job


	The Capability Engineer is responsible for executing capability development programs, supporting competency assessments, and facilitating knowledge transfer across assets to ensure that personnel are equipped with the skills, tools, and processes required for effective operations.
	The role supports the integration of training, digital tools, and operational practices to enhance real-time production optimization, reliability engineering, and asset integrity management. Transforms capability initiatives into practical, on-the-ground execution that directly supports production performance and operational efficiency.
	Ensures capability initiatives are translated into measurable improvements in operational performance, production efficiency, and reduction in deferment.


This position delivers measurable business value through:


	Improved workforce competency and technical capability
	Enhanced adoption of digital and operational tools
	Faster problem-solving and decision-making
	Contribution to improved production efficiency and reduced deferment


Principal Accountabilities


	Support implementation of enterprise-wide capability development frameworks across Production Assurance, Reliability, Asset Integrity, and Operations.
	Assist in development and maintenance of competency matrices, skill assessments, and training plans for technical personnel.
	Coordinate and deliver technical training programs, including:
	
		Classroom training
		On-the-job training
		Simulation-based training (e.g., OTS, digital tools)
	
	
	Support identification of capability gaps and execution of targeted interventions to close them.
	Facilitate knowledge management and documentation of best practices, lessons learned, and operational procedures.
	Support deployment and adoption of digital tools (e.g., simulators, analytics platforms, optimization tools) across operations teams.
	Provide capability support during:
	
		Commissioning
		Startup
		Operational readiness activities
	
	
	Assist in onboarding and competency development programs for new engineers and operations personnel.
	Track and report capability KPIs, including:
	
		Training completion
		Competency progression
		Skill gap closure
	
	
	Collaborate with Reliability, Asset Integrity, and Production Optimization teams to align capability initiatives with operational needs.
	Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on enhancing workforce effectiveness and operational performance
	Provide support for preparation of training materials, procedures, and technical documentation.
	Participate in audits, reviews, and assessments related to capability and training programs.
	Interface with external training providers and vendors to support capability development activities.
	Support deployment and utilization of digital production optimization and simulation tools (e.g., OTS, analytics platforms) across operations teams.


Job Context and Main Activities


	This role operates within the Operations Readiness, Production Assurance, and Capability framework, supporting capability development initiatives across assets.
	The job holder is expected to:
	
		Execute capability development programs
		Support real-time operational learning and improvement
		Facilitate training and competency development
		Assist in digital tool adoption and integration
		Support commissioning and operational readiness activities
	
	
	Acts as a key enabler of workforce effectiveness by translating capability strategies into practical execution that directly supports production performance.


Job Knowledge and Qualifications
Required Qualification:


	Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related discipline
	5 - 10 years of experience in Oil & Gas
	Exposure to:
	
		Production Operations
		Reliability / Asset Integrity
		Training / capability development.
	
	


Knowledge of:


	Production systems
	Basic reliability principles
	Digital tools and simulators
	Training and competency frameworks.


Skills:


	Strong communication and facilitation
	Analytical and problem-solving ability
	Ability to work across teams.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV in MS Word to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

IT Support and Admin Assistant Job at JSK Consulting Group




        
    

        
        JSK Consulting Group - Our client is recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the position below:

Job Position: IT Support and Admin Assistant

Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Working days: Mon - Fri

Job Description


	Our client is seeking a skilled and organised to provide technical support, coordinate vehicle management, and handle administrative duties. The successful candidate will troubleshoot IT issues, liaise with network operators, coordinate with the outsourcing company on employee-related matters, and support daily office operations.


Key Requirements
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues.
	Liaise with network operators to resolve internet and connectivity problems.
	Manage company vehicles, including drivers, maintenance, expenses, and logbooks.
	Serve as the liaison between the company and its outsourcing provider, addressing employee-related issues.
	Provide general administrative and IT support.
	Prepare and maintain records, reports, and spreadsheets.
	Coordinate effectively across departments and communicate with relevant stakeholders.


Qualifications and Skills


	Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent experience.
	Minimum of 3 years of experience in IT support, administration, or a related role.
	Proficiency in troubleshooting hardware, software, and network issues.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and record management.
	Strong communication, problem-solving, and cross-departmental coordination skills.
	Good organisational and administrative skills.


Salary
N220,000 - N300,000 / Month.

title: Job Openings at JSK Consulting Group
content:
JSK Consulting Group is a premium Human Capital Consultancy firm that works with a host of organizations building their social capital, to achieve maximum productivity and high performance. Since 2010, we have engaged in capacity building trainings, strategic facilitation, executive, leadership and team coaching, specialized talent search, personnel administration, property management and brand media promotions.

We are  recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Receptionist / Front Desk Officer

Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	They are seeking a professional and organised Receptionist / Front Desk Officer to manage front-desk operations and provide administrative support.
	The successful candidate will welcome visitors, handle phone calls, manage correspondence, coordinate meeting rooms, maintain reception-area cleanliness, and support daily office activities.


Key Requirements


	Welcome and attend to visitors, clients, and business partners professionally.
	Register visitors and maintain accurate records.
	Answer, screen, and direct incoming calls to the appropriate personnel.
	Receive and distribute mail, courier packages, and correspondence.
	Monitor reception-area office supplies and arrange replenishment when necessary.
	Schedule meetings and prepare meeting rooms, including refreshments and equipment.
	Provide administrative support, including filing, document organisation, and data entry.
	Communicate internal notices and maintain the company notice board.
	Keep the reception area clean, organised, and presentable.
	Maintain a professional appearance and excellent customer service standards.


Qualifications and Skills


	Relevant educational qualification.
	A minimum of 2 years of experience in a receptionist or administrative role is an advantage.
	Good verbal and written communication skills.
	Strong organisational, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
	Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office.
	Professional telephone etiquette and attention to detail.
	Ability to multitask and work effectively with minimal supervision.
	Must be willing to work on-site in Ikoyi, Lagos.


Salary
N200,000 - N250,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 16th November, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

2.) IT Support and Admin Assistant

Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Working days: Mon - Fri

Job Description


	Our client is seeking a skilled and organised to provide technical support, coordinate vehicle management, and handle administrative duties. The successful candidate will troubleshoot IT issues, liaise with network operators, coordinate with the outsourcing company on employee-related matters, and support daily office operations.


Key Requirements


	Troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues.
	Liaise with network operators to resolve internet and connectivity problems.
	Manage company vehicles, including drivers, maintenance, expenses, and logbooks.
	Serve as the liaison between the company and its outsourcing provider, addressing employee-related issues.
	Provide general administrative and IT support.
	Prepare and maintain records, reports, and spreadsheets.
	Coordinate effectively across departments and communicate with relevant stakeholders.


Qualifications and Skills


	Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent experience.
	Minimum of 3 years of experience in IT support, administration, or a related role.
	Proficiency in troubleshooting hardware, software, and network issues.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and record management.
	Strong communication, problem-solving, and cross-departmental coordination skills.
	Good organisational and administrative skills.


Salary
N220,000 - N300,000 / Month.

Application Closing Date: 16th November, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

3.) Senior Finance Officer (Male)

Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

Summary


	JSK Consulting Group is seeking an experienced Senior Finance Officer to manage financial operations, reporting, compliance, budgeting, and payroll for outsourced client accounts.


Requirements


	B.Sc. in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field 
	4–5 years of relevant experience (Post-NYSC)
	ICAN, ACCA, ACA, or CPA advantage
	Strong financial reporting, budgeting & reconciliation skills
	Payroll management experience (PAYE, Pension & statutory deductions)
	Knowledge of Nigerian tax & compliance * Proficiency in Excel and accounting software
	Strong analytical and leadership skills
	Consulting/outsourcing experience is an advantage.


Benefits


	Salary: N350,000 - N450,000 monthly 
	HMO
	Pension
	Leave Allowance
	Professional Development Opportunities.
